input.title: 24-Years-Owned 1990 Porsche 911 Carrera 2 Cabriolet 5-Speed
input.description: This 1990 Porsche 911 Carrera 2 cabriolet was purchased by the current owner in 2002 and was specified in Slate Grey Metallic over Silk Grey Special leather with a limited-slip differential. The odometer was repaired in 2009 and now shows 115k miles. An engine-out service was completed in 2020. The aftermarket 17" Turbo Twist-style wheels wear Michelin tires. Service records and two sets of keys accompany the car. The Carfax report is free of accidents.

notes: Repaired odometer → TMU; engine-out service is not a rebuild; clean Carfax is not a title status; owners not stated even though tenure is.

input.title: 2004 Ferrari 360 Modena F1
input.description: This 2004 Ferrari 360 Modena is finished in Rosso Corsa over Nero leather and is powered by a 3.6-liter V8 paired with a six-speed F1 automated manual transaxle. It was acquired by the selling dealer in 2025 and has 31k miles. Modifications include a Tubi exhaust system and Challenge-style rear grilles. The Carfax report lists an accident in 2011 with damage to the front, and the front bumper was subsequently repainted. The timing belts were replaced in 2023. The check-engine light is illuminated, which the seller attributes to a faulty oxygen sensor. Service records are not included.

notes: F1 is automatic; partial repaint counts; illuminated CEL is needs_work; 'records not included' means no service_records flag. Selling dealer acquired in 2025 → years_owned 1.

input.title: 55k-Kilometer Midnight Purple II 1999 Nissan Skyline GT-R
input.description: This 1999 Nissan Skyline GT-R was imported to the United States from Japan in 2024 and shows 55k kilometers (~34k miles). It is finished in Midnight Purple II over black and gray cloth and is powered by a twin-turbocharged 2.6-liter RB26DETT inline-six paired with a six-speed Getrag manual transmission. Modifications include a Nismo cat-back exhaust and an HKS boost controller, and the car retains its factory Brembo brakes. The Japanese export certificate and a stack of service invoices from the importing dealer accompany the car.

notes: Kilometers stay in km with the reading shown; factory Brembos are not an option to list; invoices → service_records.

input.title: Original-Owner 1997 Ferrari F355 GTS 6-Speed
input.description: This 1997 Ferrari F355 GTS was purchased new by the seller from Ferrari of Beverly Hills and has remained in their care since. It is finished in Giallo Modena over tan leather and powered by a 3.5-liter V8 paired with a gated six-speed manual transaxle. A Tubi exhaust was fitted in 2001. The engine-out major service was performed in 2022. The odometer is not mentioned in this listing.

notes: No odometer reading → mileage null, tmu false. Original owner → owners 1; 'purchased new' without a year → years_owned null.

input.title: 2005 BMW M3 Coupe SMG
essentials: Six-Speed SMG II Automated Manual Transmission
input.description: This 2005 BMW M3 coupe is finished in Interlagos Blue Metallic over Cinnamon Nappa leather and was ordered with the Competition Package. Power comes from a 3.2-liter S54 inline-six paired with a six-speed SMG II automated manual transmission. The hood and front bumper were repainted following stone-chip repair in 2019. The car shows 88k miles, and the seller notes that the SMG hydraulic pump was replaced in 2023. The rear subframe was reinforced in 2021. The seller reports a small oil leak from the VANOS unit.

expected.transmission_detail: Six-Speed SMG II Automated Manual Transmission

notes: SMG is automatic; repaint from stone-chip repair; oil leak is needs_work; subframe reinforcement is a repair, not a modification.

input.title: 1971 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40
input.description: This 1971 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40 was refinished in Rustic Green in 2015 and rides on 33" BFGoodrich tires with white-painted steel wheels. Power is provided by a 3.9-liter F inline-six paired with a three-speed manual transmission and a dual-range transfer case. The truck carries a salvage title issued in Arizona in 1998 following a theft recovery. Surface corrosion is visible on the rear crossmember and floor pans, and the five-digit odometer shows 31k miles, though total mileage is unknown. The seller notes the fuel gauge does not work.
input.car: Toyota Land Cruiser — FJ40 Land Cruiser (1958–1984)

notes: Salvage title; refinished → repaint; surface corrosion; five-digit odometer with unknown total → TMU; broken gauge → needs_work.

input.title: 2011 Porsche 911 GT3 RS
input.description: This 2011 Porsche 911 GT3 RS is finished in Grey Black over black Alcantara and is powered by a 3.8-liter flat-six paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. The car was optioned with the front axle lift system and carbon ceramic brakes. The seller has driven the car in several HPDE events at Laguna Seca and Thunderhill, and the rear tires were replaced in early 2026. Service has been performed by Porsche dealers, with records back to new included in the sale. The car has 23k miles.

notes: HPDE events → track_use; new tires are wear items, not modifications; Grey Black is a black paint name.

input.title: 2024 Porsche 911 GT3 RS Weissach
input.description: This 2024 Porsche 911 GT3 RS was delivered new in 2024 and shows 1,400 miles. It is finished in Guards Red over black leather and Race-Tex and equipped with the Weissach Package and forged magnesium wheels. Power comes from a 4.0-liter flat-six paired with a seven-speed PDK dual-clutch transaxle. The car remains under factory warranty and the window sticker is included.

notes: PDK is automatic; a window sticker is not service records; nothing negative.

input.title: V8-Powered 1968 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40
input.description: This 1968 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40 was refurbished between 2018 and 2020, during which its original inline-six was replaced with a 5.3-liter LS-series V8 paired with a four-speed automatic transmission. The body was repainted in Nebula Green, and the interior was retrimmed in tan leather. Additional modifications include a power steering conversion, front disc brakes, and an aluminum radiator. The odometer was replaced during the refurbishment, so true mileage is unknown. The truck is offered with a clean California title.
input.car: Toyota Land Cruiser — FJ40 Land Cruiser (1958–1984)

notes: Engine swap → flag and modification; TMU with no reading (mileage null, tmu true); clean title stated.

input.title: 2013 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG GT
input.description: This 2013 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG GT is finished in Iridium Silver Metallic over designo Classic Red leather and shows 9k miles. The 6.2-liter M159 V8 is paired with a seven-speed dual-clutch transaxle. Factory options include the Bang & Olufsen sound system and carbon fiber interior trim. The car has had two owners and was serviced at Mercedes-Benz of Scottsdale in 2025; records from that visit are included.

notes: Silver, not grey; dual-clutch is automatic; two owners stated.

input.title: 2019 Porsche 911 GT3 RS
essentials: Chalk Paint With Satin Black Wrap
input.description: This 2019 Porsche 911 GT3 RS was specified in Chalk and is currently wrapped in satin black. It shows 6k miles and is powered by a 4.0-liter flat-six paired with a seven-speed PDK. The Weissach Package was optioned from the factory, and a front-end paint protection film was applied beneath the wrap. Two keys and the owner's manuals are included.

notes: Wrap does not change the paint colour (Chalk is a white); the wrap is a modification, paint protection film is not.

input.title: 29k-Mile 1997 Porsche 911 Turbo
input.description: This 1997 Porsche 911 Turbo was specified in paint-to-sample Grand Prix White over Cashmere Beige leather upholstery, and it is powered by a twin-turbocharged 3.6-liter flat-six paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. It shows 29k miles and has been serviced by

notes: Excerpt-only input, cut mid-sentence: extract what's there, no flags from a dangling 'serviced by'.

input.title: 1974 Ford Bronco 302
input.description: This 1974 Ford Bronco is finished in Wimbledon White with a blue roof and blue vinyl upholstery and is powered by a 302ci V8 paired with a three-speed automatic transmission. The Bronco was rebuilt after a rollover in 2006 and carries a rebuilt title from Texas. The five-digit odometer shows 62k miles, with total mileage unknown. Work in 2024 included a rebuilt carburetor and new shocks. The seller notes the rear window latch is broken.

notes: Rollover + rebuilt title → accident_history and rebuilt; two-tone → main colour white; carburetor rebuild is service, not an engine rebuild.

input.title: 1988 Lamborghini Countach 5000 QV
input.description: This 1988 Lamborghini Countach 5000 Quattrovalvole is one of the fuel-injected examples built for the US market. It is finished in Bianco over Nero leather and powered by a 5.2-liter V12 paired with a five-speed manual transaxle. The car has had three owners, the most recent of whom purchased it in 2016. It shows 19k kilometers, and the clutch was replaced in 2023. A binder of invoices dating back to 1994 accompanies the sale.

notes: Owners 3; purchased 2016, closed 2026 → 10 years; Bianco → white; clutch replacement is service.

input.title: Modified 1994 Toyota Supra Turbo 6-Speed
input.description: This 1994 Toyota Supra Turbo has been modified with a single-turbo conversion using a Precision 6266 turbocharger, an HKS intercooler, coilover suspension, and an AEM engine management system, and the seller reports 620 horsepower on a dynamometer. It is finished in Renaissance Red over black leather and shows 98k miles. The six-speed Getrag manual transmission was rebuilt in 2022. The car was repainted in its original color in 2018. Rust is not present according to the seller.

notes: Heavy modifications; repaint in original colour still counts; gearbox rebuild is neither engine nor a modification; 'rust not present' → no rust flag.

input.title: 1992 Acura NSX Automatic
input.description: This 1992 Acura NSX is finished in Formula Red over ivory leather and is one of the examples equipped from the factory with a four-speed automatic transmission. The 3.0-liter C30A V6 was refreshed with a timing belt and water pump service in 2024. The car shows 74k miles and is offered with a clean Ohio title. The seller notes that the driver-side window regulator is slow.

notes: Torque-converter automatic; timing belt service is not a rebuild; slow regulator → needs_work.

input.title: 2006 Honda S2000
input.description: This 2006 Honda S2000 is finished in Berlina Black over black leather and shows 41k miles. It is equipped with a six-speed manual transmission.

notes: Short listing: engine not stated → null, no flags, no options.

input.title: 1991 Land Rover Defender 90 200Tdi
input.description: This 1991 Land Rover Defender 90 was imported to the US in 2021 and shows 121k kilometers. It is finished in Arles Blue over gray cloth and is powered by a 2.5-liter 200Tdi turbodiesel inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transmission. The chassis was undersealed in 2022, and bubbling is visible beneath the paint on the rear door frame. An aftermarket snorkel and a steel rear bumper have been fitted. The seller states that the truck has had two owners since import.

notes: Bubbling paint → rust; 'two owners since import' is not a total owner count → owners null.

input.title: 1991 Ferrari F40
input.description: This 1991 Ferrari F40 is a European-specification example that shows 8k kilometers. It is finished in Rosso Corsa over red cloth and retains its twin-turbocharged 2.9-liter V8 and five-speed manual transaxle. The car received Ferrari Classiche certification in 2019 and a major service in 2024. It is offered on a bill of sale, as the seller notes it has not been titled in the United States.

notes: Bill of sale → title_status other; Classiche certification is a value-moving item.

input.title: 2005 Ford GT
input.description: This 2005 Ford GT is finished in Quick Silver with Ebony leather and is equipped with all four factory options: painted stripes, forged BBS wheels, a McIntosh stereo, and red-painted brake calipers. The supercharged 5.4-liter V8 is paired with a six-speed manual transaxle. The car has had two owners from new and shows 2,100 miles. The seller reports that the original tires remain fitted and recommends replacement before spirited driving.

notes: Old tires the seller says to replace → needs_work; options enumerated.

input.title: 1999 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI Tommi Makinen Edition
input.description: This 1999 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VI Tommi Makinen Edition was imported from Japan in 2025 and shows 72k kilometers. It was repainted in its original Passion Red in 2020. Power is provided by a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4G63 inline-four paired with a five-speed manual transmission and all-wheel drive. The car was used in several time-attack events at Tsukuba Circuit by its previous owner and is fitted with a Ralliart exhaust. Japanese service stamps are present in the maintenance booklet.

notes: Interior colour not stated (only Recaro cloth) → null; time attack → track_use; stamped booklet → service_records.

input.title: 1996 Porsche 911 Carrera Coupe 6-Speed
input.description: This 1996 Porsche 911 Carrera coupe was purchased by the seller in 2017 and shows 67k miles. It is finished in Polar Silver Metallic over Classic Grey leather and was factory-equipped with the Aerokit and a limited-slip differential. The 3.6-liter flat-six was fitted with replacement valve guides during a top-end refresh in 2019, and the six-speed manual transaxle received a new clutch at the same time. The car is accompanied by a Porsche Certificate of Authenticity and service records since 2009.

notes: Top-end refresh is not a rebuild; purchased 2017 → 9 years owned; owners unknown.

input.title: 1979 Chevrolet K5 Blazer Cheyenne 4x4
input.description: This 1979 Chevrolet K5 Blazer Cheyenne was repainted in Santa Fe Tan in 2021 following the repair of collision damage to the driver-side quarter panel. A 400ci V8 is paired with a three-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case. The odometer was replaced at an unknown point, so mileage is unknown. The truck rides on a 2" lift with 33" tires and has an aftermarket stereo. The seller notes the air conditioning does not blow cold.

notes: Collision repair → accident_history; tan → brown; replaced odometer with no reading → tmu true, mileage null.

input.title: 1988 Porsche 911 Turbo Cabriolet M505 Slant Nose
input.description: This 1988 Porsche 911 Turbo cabriolet is a factory M505 Slant Nose example finished in Zermatt Silver Metallic over champagne leather. It shows 38k miles and is powered by a turbocharged 3.3-liter flat-six paired with a four-speed manual transaxle. The car was purchased by the current owner in 1998 and has been stored in a climate-controlled garage. A Porsche Certificate of Authenticity confirms the original specification.

notes: Interior champagne is an interior colour (not exterior family); 28 years owned.

input.title: 1997 Lamborghini Diablo VT Roadster
input.description: This 1997 Lamborghini Diablo VT Roadster is finished in Arancio over black leather and shows 14k miles. The 5.7-liter V12 was rebuilt in 2021 by a marque specialist following a valve failure, at a cost of approximately $60k, and the work is documented in invoices included with the sale. Power is sent through a five-speed manual transaxle with all-wheel drive. The seller notes a small crack in the dashboard leather.

notes: Engine rebuild flag; invoices → service_records; a cracked dash is cosmetic, not needs_work; Arancio → orange.
